features.name: String Resources In XAML
features.description: A TextBlock uses x:Uid to load a localized string resource (WelcomeHeader) from resources.resw.

features.name: File Resources In XAML
features.description: Image elements reference logical images that resolve to physical scale/language/contrast variants in the package.
expected_behaviour: Two images (scale variant, language+scale variant) are displayed

features.name: String Resources In Code
features.description: ResourceLoader is used to load a string resource in code; a Show Message button displays it.
expected_behaviour: Clicking 'Show Message' displays the localized string 'Hello World'

features.name: Resources in the AppX manifest
expected_behaviour: Descriptive text about AppX manifest resources is shown

features.name: Additional Resource Files
features.description: Loading strings from additional .resw files via path-absolute URIs; Show Message button.
expected_behaviour: Descriptive text + Show Message button present and wired

features.name: Class Library Resources
features.description: Retrieve resources from a class library; Show Message button.
expected_behaviour: Descriptive text + Show Message button present and wired

features.name: Runtime Changes/Events
features.description: React to language/scale/contrast changes at runtime; Show Message button.
expected_behaviour: Descriptive text + Show Message button present and wired

features.name: Application Languages
features.description: Shows app languages and PrimaryLanguageOverride via a ComboBox + Show Message.
expected_behaviour: Shows current app language(s), e.g. 'en-US, fr-FR'

features.name: Override Languages
features.description: Overrides app languages using ResourceContext.GetForCurrentView (per-view language override).

features.name: Multi-dimensional fallback
features.description: Choose Language/Scale/Contrast/HomeRegion qualifiers and view the resolved resource.
expected_behaviour: Show Message resolves the qualified resource

features.name: Working with webservices

expected_behaviour: Clicking 'Get Url' displays a resolved URL, e.g. http://api.contoso.com/Feed?lang=en

features.name: Retrieving resources in non-UI threads

expected_behaviour: View-dependent and view-independent resource outputs shown
